_comment: Curated Hypothetical-Mode scenarios for space-weather.html. Read-only; add new scenarios to the array (no code change). Inputs are upstream solar-wind drivers (Bz, v, n, By); all downstream indices (Pdyn, Dst, Kp, HP) are MODELED from these via the named coupling functions (O'Brien-McPherron 2002, Newell 2007/2009) — never dialed directly. Provenance per scenario notes where the input values came from.

scenarios.label: Quiet baseline
scenarios.description: Solar-minimum conditions, typical quiet day. Reference state.
scenarios.provenance: Nominal slow solar wind (OMNI climatological median).

scenarios.label: G3 storm (moderate)
scenarios.description: Typical moderate geomagnetic storm. A few per year near solar max.
scenarios.provenance: Representative CIR/CME-sheath values for a G3 (Kp 7) event.

scenarios.label: Gannon-class (G5)
scenarios.description: May 2024 Gannon Storm analog. CME-driven, prolonged southward Bz.
scenarios.provenance: DSCOVR/ACE L1 values during the 2024-05-10/11 main phase (peak Dst −412 nT).

scenarios.label: Halloween 2003 analog
scenarios.description: Multiple-CME sequence; coronagraphs saturated; X17/X28 flares.
scenarios.provenance: ACE sheath values 2003-10-29/30 (peak Dst −383 nT; some sensors saturated).

scenarios.label: Carrington-class (1859 analog)
scenarios.description: Historic extreme. ~1-in-150-year event. No modern instrument equivalent.
scenarios.warning: Conditions outside the modern observational range. Empirical models are EXTRAPOLATED — treat as illustrative, not quantitative.

scenarios.label: Starlink Loss (Feb 2022)
scenarios.description: A modest G1 storm that destroyed 38 of 49 Starlink satellites via thermospheric drag. The case for physics-first drag prediction.
scenarios.provenance: L1 values 2022-02-03 (Dst ≈ −66 nT; NRLMSIS underpredicted ρ@210-km by ~30%).

scenarios.label: Fast coronal-hole stream
scenarios.description: High-speed stream from a recurrent coronal hole — fast wind, low density, weak/variable Bz. Common at the declining phase of a cycle.
scenarios.provenance: Typical CIR/HSS trailing-edge values (low n, high v).
